scope: Public table types, inherited part members, constructors, cell/row/column collection protocols and adjacent table accessors remain explicit obligations, including underscore-prefixed types.
notice: Research/provenance; required standalone notices remain upstream-license-notice.txt and public-api-map-notice.txt.

languageSecurityMappings.names: Neutral Table, cell, iter_cells, first_row, margin_left, text_frame names remain primary model spellings. CLI/operation JSON uses camelCase only. Underscore-prefixed documented types are public obligations.
languageSecurityMappings.collections: Zero-based numeric collection[index] and get(index), length and Symbol.iterator; reject negative, fractional and out-of-range indexes. CLI locations are one-based. No negative at or slice is invented.
languageSecurityMappings.identity: Live views retain owned physical a:tc identity; logical covered positions must not be conflated with physically serialized cells. Source equality maps to documented owner/node equality rather than Python wrapper identity.
languageSecurityMappings.null: undefined leaves operation fields unchanged. null margins/anchor remove direct overrides; fill:null and borderColor:null explicitly write noFill. Null is field-specific, not universally inheritance. Empty text is a value.
languageSecurityMappings.units: Finite safe numeric EMU model lengths and explicit unit-tagged operation lengths. No boolean-to-number coercion; integer validation before mutation.
languageSecurityMappings.errors: Neutral OfficeError with invalid-value in usage phase (CLI exit 2), invalid-selection in select phase (exit 1), and unsupported-edit in validate-intent phase (exit 1); whole API limitations stay visible.
languageSecurityMappings.io: Async input/save through explicit VFS or supplied bytes; synchronous in-memory table properties. No ambient host files, native runtime, network, fonts, clock or executable input.
languageSecurityMappings.constructors: Returned owned table interfaces do not promise unchecked raw XML construction. Inherited part is an owned package view, not an unrestricted ZIP or host handle.
languageSecurityMappings.drift: Published version 1.0.0 versus pinned source 1.0.2 is historical drift. Prose cell row_idx/col_idx are documentation errors, not hidden missing APIs. Public enums and returned fill/text-frame graphs remain separate full API obligations.
languageSecurityMappings.coordinates: Package readTables/addTable/mutateTables options.cell is a one-based string such as 1,2, matching CLI --cell. Package updates reject update.cell. Internal TableUpdate.cell uses zero-based {row,column}; live Table.cell and collection indexing are also zero-based.
languageSecurityMappings.spans: Model merge(other_cell) normalizes opposite corners; direct ordered from/to rejects reversed coordinates. Complete prior merges may be absorbed, unlike the pinned reject-any-merge baseline; partial intersections reject. Split only accepts an origin and never redistributes prior cell text.
languageSecurityMappings.structuralHandles: Successful row/column insertion/deletion invalidates existing cell, row, column, row-cell collection and bound text-frame handles with invalid-selection. Table.rows and Table.columns remain live positional collections. Merge/split preserves coordinate handles.
languageSecurityMappings.conflictPolicy: CLI position is one-based; restructureTables.operation.position is zero-based. Both insert before the specified row/column, with CLI length+1 or typed operation length appending. Addition requires expand or reject; removal requires shrink or reject. Inserted size copies the following row/column, or preceding one on append. Removal may not leave zero rows/columns.

documentationDrift: Historical public-api-map.json batch entries such as tables.table.cell.marginLeft.set are proposed design records, not executable routes. Current direct operations use tables list/get/add/set; do not advertise a generic member evaluator.
Operation inspection reports direct margins as nullable EMU values; live model margin_left etc must return defaults 91440 horizontal and 45720 vertical when absent. These are distinct surfaces.

F29 direct routes and retained merge/split model methods are implemented by this bounded change. Historical generic tables.table.* evaluator paths remain proposed and are not executable aliases. Split requires an explicit coordinate cell selector; cell token selection is not exposed.
